title: AI lead attribution gap - checked figures

layers.2-disclosed: asked or disclosed by the company

facts.claim: Share of US consumers who used an AI tool for local business recommendations
facts.source_type: Industry report (primary, survey n=1,002 US adults)

facts.claim: AI users who fact-check the sources behind an AI recommendation
facts.value: 88% (51% check the review is legitimate, 37% check the source), n=455 AI users

facts.claim: B2B software buyers who start vendor research in an AI chatbot
facts.value: 51%; AI chatbots 37% vs review sites 38% as most influential source
facts.source_name: G2 2026 Buyer Behavior Report (via Demand Gen Report and MarketScale)
facts.source_type: Industry report, accessed through secondary coverage
facts.note: Original G2 report page not retrievable on 2026-09-21; two independent secondary reports agree.

facts.claim: Business buyers who use AI in their buying process
facts.source_name: Forrester blog, John Buten, 'B2B Buyers Make Zero-Click Buying Number One'
facts.note: The 94% in Forrester's 21 Jan 2026 press release refers to buying-group benefits, not AI use. The AI-use 94% is in the analyst blog of 22 Jan 2026. The ~18,000 sample is reported by secondary sources only.

facts.claim: Self-reported lead source 'ChatGPT / AI' on a 'How did you hear about us?' field
facts.source_type: Company first-party data (primary, self-reported, n not disclosed)
facts.note: Single B2B SaaS vendor; sample size not published.

facts.claim: Share of new Vercel signups referred by ChatGPT
facts.source_name: Guillermo Rauch, Vercel CEO, on X
facts.note: Developer-tool audience, heavy ChatGPT users; an upper bound rather than typical.

facts.claim: Share of Webflow new signups coming from AI
facts.value: 2% (Oct 2024) -> 8% (Jun 2025); signup conversion 24% from LLM traffic vs 4% non-brand SEO
facts.source_name: Webflow blog, 'How we're optimizing for AI search at Webflow'

facts.claim: Share of Tally new signups facilitated by ChatGPT
facts.source_name: Foundation Inc, quoting co-founder Marie Martens
facts.source_type: Reputable trade coverage of founder disclosure
facts.note: Free form builder with a maker audience; an upper bound.

facts.claim: Cognism inbound data: LLMs as last-touch MQL source and self-reported AI attribution
facts.value: +345% YoY as last-touch source for MQLs; self-reported AI/LLM attribution +9.25% YoY; organic traffic -33.6% YoY while direct MQLs +6%
facts.note: Report does not state whether +9.25% is relative or percentage points; present as stated.

facts.claim: Ahrefs: AI search share of visitors vs share of signups
Share of inbound calls that originate from AI search, small and mid-sized businesses
facts.value: 0.073% across ~20M inbound leads; legal 0.175%, manufacturing 0.093%, marketing agencies 0.091%; ChatGPT 90.1%, Perplexity 6.3%, Gemini 2.4%, Claude 1.2% of AI-sourced leads
facts.source_name: CallRail, 'What 20M calls reveal about the future of customer discovery'

facts.claim: Average website's share of traffic from AI chatbots
facts.value: 0.17%; 63% of 3,000 sites receive some AI traffic
facts.note: Feb 2025 - the oldest tracked figure here; kept as the baseline the later numbers grow from.

facts.claim: AI search share of B2B search sessions
facts.value: under 2% of 25M sessions (Sep 2025 - Mar 2026); ChatGPT share of AI referrals 86% (Oct 2025) -> 72% (Feb 2026); Gemini 4.5% -> 13.0%
facts.source_name: Octane11 State of B2B AI Search, Vol. 1

facts.value: median visit -> hand-raiser 5.24%; hand-raiser -> qualified pipeline 2.66%; pipeline -> closed-won median 0%; 86% of hand-raisers high intent; ChatGPT 82% of LLM sessions

facts.claim: Dreamdata own instance: LLM-surfaced content influence
facts.value: 1.1% of MQLs vs 6.2% of new business closed, last 12 months
facts.source_name: Dreamdata recipe 'Tracking LLM influence on pipeline and revenue'
facts.source_type: Vendor first-party worked example (primary, n=1 company)
facts.note: Publication date not shown on page; data window is 'last 12 months' with LLM traffic rising since early 2025.

facts.claim: Monthly ChatGPT referral visits to B2B properties measured by Demandbase
facts.source_name: Labs by Demandbase, via PPC Land
facts.source_type: Reputable trade coverage of vendor release

facts.claim: What happens after ChatGPT recommends a brand
facts.value: 2.5x more likely to get a site visit within 7 days; 55.9% of that downstream traffic arrives via branded search; 12.0 pages / 11.8 min vs 6.5 pages / 5.6 min
facts.source_name: Similarweb, 'The Downstream Impact of AI Visibility' (US desktop panel, Jul 2025 - Jan 2026, finance / travel / beauty)
facts.source_type: Panel study, accessed through secondary coverage
facts.note: Similarweb's own report URL returned 404 on 2026-09-21.

facts.claim: Modelled value of an AI search visitor vs a traditional organic visitor
facts.note: A model estimate, not a measured conversion rate.

facts.claim: Why AI-created demand is invisible to last-click
facts.value: copy-paste becomes Direct, branded re-search becomes Organic, a no-link mention becomes no event
facts.source_name: Radyant guide to AI search attribution

claims_not_traced.claim: Radyant 2026 client data: up to 30% of leads self-report AI discovery
claims_not_traced.finding: Repeated by derivatex.agency and several other blogs. Not present in Radyant's own attribution guide, which uses 20% of closed-won deals as a hypothetical. No primary source located on 2026-09-21. Usable only as an explicitly untraced claim.

claims_not_traced.claim: CallRail: AI search traffic converts at 14.2% vs Google 2.8%
claims_not_traced.finding: Not in the CallRail press release, the citybiz Q&A or the SEJ piece. The 14.2% vs 2.8% figure belongs to Opollo's B2B tech data (cited on stanislav-peev.com/research/ai-referral-traffic-conversion-vs-organic/). Kept out of the CallRail row.

claims_not_traced.claim: Tally: 44% of ~40,000 weekly signups via AI assistants
claims_not_traced.finding: Seen only in a search snippet. Dropped unless a primary post is located.
Sample size is not in the Forrester blog or press release that were read; omit or attribute to secondary coverage.
